data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出TeSearch用质量-多样性进化搜索小而强的测试套件，作为自演化代理环内改进信号，持续筛选后续改写；属可复用验证器改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable,
scope_support.object_quote: We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm
scope_support.persistence_quote: Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3% for the repository's tests
